Maya (Growth Marketing): Quick ask — need launch assets for next Thu webinar. Scope: postcard (print + web), 1-pg sales handoff PDF, hero banner, and 3 social copy variants. Deadline Wed COB.
Ethan (Creative Lead): Got it. Which metrics?
Maya (Growth Marketing): p50 latency @512 tokens, tokens/sec @16k batch, cost/1k tokens hosted vs dedicated, caching delta. Use only eval doc numbers.
Rory (Content): Tone: engineer-first, accessible to revenue. Headline draft: 'Smarter serving, lower costs — real benchmarks'.
Priya (Design): Formats: postcard 5x7 CMYK PDF, 1200x628 hero, 800x800 socials, one-pager 8.5x11 editable in Figma. Need accessibility alt colors?
Ethan (Creative Lead): Yes — primary + high-contrast variant. Use system legend for axes.
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/serving-wins-launch-kit — comment access open.
LegalBot: Any quantitative claim needs a source line with eval link and test date. Avoid unsourced % claims.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Eval link: https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/production-bench-2026 (internal).
Priya (Design): I'll add small-type footnote area and an accessibility pass. Also include a 1080x1920 story card.
Ethan (Creative Lead): Deliverable checklist: postcard (print + web), one-pager PDF, hero PNG+SVG, socials x3, alt-color variant, contrast report, legal footnote.
Rory (Content): I'll draft bullets and 3 short social lines by tomorrow.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Sales routing metadata for one-pager — add to Figma notes:
```
utm_source=serving_wins_campaign
utm_medium=postcard
webhook_id=srv-win-2026
```
Priya (Design): Will push initial comps Mon noon, iterate Tues, legal review Wed AM, final Wed COB.
Ethan (Creative Lead): If print proofs needed, order Tue AM — Maya confirm qty.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Start with 200 to HQ, 100 to SF. I'll confirm addresses.
LegalBot: I'll review claims after upload; expect ~6hr turnaround for small copy.
Priya (Design): Starting comps now. Will ping when live in Figma. :rocket:
